title: Passing massive body rearranged the planets and stripped Mars's atmosphere

tellings.quote: system some big object passed through our solar system that did that with it's with its uh gravity field

plain: Some large object once passed through our solar system and, with its gravity, rearranged the planets and stripped Mars of its atmosphere. Joe McMoneagle, a guest who argues that Mars once had life, tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, it would explain how Mars became the dead planet it is now.
